about: ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English) descriptions of the static base tools, for ToolListMode static with ToolDescStyle ste (the A/B/C test of 17 Nov 2026). Short sentences, one idea each, active voice. Every hard limit of the full text is kept; the detail moves to guide_read { topic: "batch" }.

entries.session_state: Read the document. For each shown body: volume, area, faces, solids, size (mm). Also: the step count, running jobs, the output folder. In the window, next is one short line: what FreeCAD is doing now (a dialog and its buttons first, a sketch in edit and its DoF, an open task panel), then up to 3 likely next tools with why, then the workbench and the status bar text. No tool is named while a dialog is open: use dialog_answer. leftOut and warning: an installed add-on did not load (its tools are missing; the error says why). toolsChanged: the tool list changed since the client read it. launcher: true adds the launcher's state. mismatch: the document in front is not the agent's document; doc_switch to the agent's document binds both again. documents: every open document (name, label, unsaved, byAgent). orient: true gives only a short read: where, the documents, the agent's document, its bodies and the options. Changes nothing.
entries.guide_read: Read how to do a task: workflows and traps that the tool descriptions do not give. No topic: the index (guides, their sections, and the cost of each in tokens; start: the section to read first). topic: one guide, or a list of guides in one answer (next: the topics not read). section: one ## section, or a list. Read the Start here section first, then the sections it names. Changes nothing.
entries.batch: Run tools in one call. The calls run one at a time, in order: a call sees what the calls before it made. calls: [{ tool, arguments }], or file: a .json file with that list. The first refused call stops the batch (stopOnError: false runs all). The calls before it stay, each its own undo step. The answer has done, refused (the call, its code, kind and error) and notRun, counted from 0. next is the refused call: fix it, then from: next continues. A call with a wrong form is refused by itself, in its order. rollback: true undoes the whole batch when it stops. With rollback: at most 20 changing calls. A batch cannot hold a batch. budget: seconds, 55 by default, 100 at most; a call does not start after it; the answer then has next, and from: next continues. to: write the whole answer to a .json file; the reply then has one line per call. lines: "all" (default), "refused", "counts" or "full". Every batch writes a record in batches/ in the session folder: if an answer is lost, read the newest record before you run calls again. read + at: get one part of a record or a to file; nothing runs. Use the answer of an earlier call of this batch with { "$from": 2, "$at": "bodies.0.name" } (call 2, counted from 0). Do not type a name or id that an earlier call will give: use $from. build: "end" recomputes once for a run of sketch and property changes. For $file, to on a call, builds, timings and the window pace, read guide_read { topic: "batch" }.
entries.tool_find: Find tools. words: what the tool does, in plain words ("fillet edge"). queries: a list of searches (up to 6) and tool names (up to 20) in one call. Each hit: name, group, one line. tool: a name or a list of names: get the full description and inputs (cards), with example: a ready call from the open document (copy it, and give the values in fill). A name with a prefix, other letter case or a letter wrong is read as the name. tool and queries can be in one call. groups: true lists the tool groups. group: search in one group only. Any tool can be called by name, listed or not; where the client sends only listed tools, call it in batch { calls: [{ tool, arguments }] }. Changes nothing.
